name: Cellular Matrix points
purpose: Recoverable exertion reserve used by anomalous abilities; CM is not health and cannot substitute for HP.

capacity.recalculation: Only through an explicit progression/stat migration; ordinary ability use never permanently reduces CM maximum.

rules: Recovery requires real elapsed world time.
Severe injury, dehydration, starvation, illness or interrupted sleep may reduce recovery.
Ordinary food supports recovery but does not grant an instant fixed CM bonus unless a named item or effect says so.

bands.effects: noticeable exertion; repeated high-intensity use contributes to fatigue
-1 to sustained anomalous-ability checks; headache/tremor may appear
-2 to sustained anomalous-ability checks; nausea, tremor and coordination loss
disadvantage on strenuous anomalous-ability checks; severe instability/collapse risk
critical depletion; severe confusion/nausea and high collapse/misfire risk
forced anomalous-ability shutdown; no CM-costing action may start

spending_rules: An action requiring more CM than currently available cannot start unless a separately defined overdraw mechanic explicitly allows it.
Completed CM costs persist if an action later causes other consequences; failed-attempt cost is defined by the specific ability/system.
